issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: First Defendant Charged in Autism Fraud Scheme
notes: USAO-MN primary government release announcing Asha Farhan Hassan's federal Information. The release covers both a $14 million EIDBI autism-fraud allegation and a separate Feeding Our Future / Federal Child Nutrition Program allegation involving Smart Therapy. Keep those programs and amounts distinct.
supports: Asha Farhan Hassan, age 28, was charged by federal information with wire fraud on September 24, 2025.
USAO-MN states Hassan was also charged with participating in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme through Smart Therapy.
For the Feeding Our Future conduct, USAO-MN states Hassan claimed nearly 200,000 meals between 2020 and 2021 and approximately $465,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.
Separately, USAO-MN alleges Smart Therapy obtained more than $14 million in EIDBI reimbursement funds in the autism-fraud scheme.
does_not_support: The release does not itself call Hassan the 76th Feeding Our Future defendant; that ordinal comes from maintained secondary rosters.
The $14 million autism-program amount and approximately $465,000 child-nutrition amount are different programs and must not be summed as one Feeding Our Future loss figure.
Charging allegations are not adjudicated facts.
